Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the title block
The first draft initiated by eng.Gamal El Sdik, 
reviewed eng. Mahmoud Abd El Hamid El Kholi, reviewed by EDEPC inspection and 
quality control eng. Adel Abd El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. Awad 
Fathy head sector of Talkha PS
This document
accepted by Samir Abd El-Gilil, EDEPC MPIS 
coordinator, 
and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed 
Soliman admin and financial inspection quality controls general director, and 
supervisor of EDEPC inspection and quality controls head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by any one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc.
Generator isolation 
 and proper earthing is required.
Ensure that the circuit breaker disconnected 
 and secondary disconnect.
Tools and Equipments
Safety and healthy equipment helmet, shoes, ... etc
Complete tool set, Brushes
Megger, Digital voltammeter
Work to be Carried out
Inspection Steps
Item | Inspection Steps | Test 
 Results
1 | Clean the mating surface of 
 the metal clad. | 
2 | Check the control voltage 
 value. | 
3 | Check the racking mechanism 
 to make certain that it is in the disconnect position. | 
4 | Close the CB manually. | 
5 | Open the CB manually. | 
6 | Check the charging and 
 discharging CB. | 
7 | Check the closing time of breaker. | 
8 | Check the tripping time of breaker. | 
9 | Check the primary circuit 
 insulation on the breaker phase to phase, phase to ground may be checked. | 
10 | Check the DC Resistance | 
11 | Lubricate the breaker 
 operating mechanism. | 
12 | Paint the CB and 
 accessories. | 
13 | Clean the disconnecting switch for the auxiliary transformer. | 
14 | Check the disconnecting switch for the auxiliary transformer. |
